description: This is a test script for the ImageAI library's video object detection functionality, including tests for different models and custom objects, as well as callback functions for frame and second-wise processing.

classes.name: CallbackFunctions
classes.description: Contains callback functions for processing each frame and each second during video detection, with assertions to verify output types.

methods.name: delete_cache
methods.description: Deletes specified cache files if they exist.

methods.name: test_video_detection_retinanet
methods.description: Tests object detection on a video using RetinaNet model.

methods.name: test_video_detection_retinanet_custom_objects
methods.description: Tests object detection with custom objects using RetinaNet model.

methods.name: test_video_detection_yolov3
methods.description: Tests object detection on a video using YOLOv3 model.

methods.name: test_video_detection_tiny_yolov3
methods.description: Tests object detection on a video using Tiny YOLOv3 model.

methods.name: test_video_detection_retinanet_analysis
methods.description: Tests the detection process with callback functions and verifies they are called.
